import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        int flow, capacity;
        int cost;

        Edge(int to, int rev, int flow, int capacity, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    int totalNodes;
    int INF = (int) 1e9;
    int[] dist, potential, prevNode, prevEdge;
    int[] flowCurrent;
    List<List<Edge>> adjacency;

    public MinCostFlow(int n) {
        this.totalNodes = n;
        dist = new int[n];
        potential = new int[n];
        flowCurrent = new int[n];
        prevNode = new int[n];
        prevEdge = new int[n];
        adjacency = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adjacency.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cst) {
        adjacency.get(s).add(new Edge(t, adjacency.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
        adjacency.get(t).add(new Edge(s, adjacency.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    int[] computeMinCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (true) {
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            flowCurrent[s] = INF;
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] p = pq.poll();
                int d = p[0], u = p[1];
                if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < adjacency.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = adjacency.get(u).get(i);
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (e.capacity <= e.flow) continue;
                    int newDist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                    if (dist[v] > newDist) {
                        dist[v] = newDist;
                        pq.offer(new int[]{newDist, v});
                        prevNode[v] = u;
                        prevEdge[v] = i;
                        flowCurrent[v] = Math.min(flowCurrent[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) {
                potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
            int delta = Math.min(flowCurrent[t], INF - totalFlow);
            totalFlow += delta;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                Edge e = adjacency.get(prevNode[v]).get(prevEdge[v]);
                e.flow += delta;
                adjacency.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= delta;
                totalCost += delta * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
}

public class Main {
    static final int T = 150;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int N = n * T;
        MinCostFlow flowObj = new MinCostFlow(N + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                flowObj.addEdge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            flowObj.addEdge(i, N + 1, INF, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            flowObj.addEdge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                int cur = 1;
                for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                    flowObj.addEdge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    flowObj.addEdge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    cur += 2;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] flowRes = flowObj.computeMinCostMaxFlow(N, N + 1);
        if (flowRes[0] != k) {
            System.out.println("0");
        } else {
            System.out.println(flowRes[1]);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
